concerns.text: Task T013 explicitly forbids generating SMILES from 3D geometry ('DO NOT generate SMILES... skip the record or raise an error'), directly contradicting spec.md FR-002 and US1 Acceptance Scenario 2 which mandate RDKit generation from 3D geometry as the fallback. This semantic weakening prevents the pipeline from achieving the mandatory SC-001 (≥500 records) if metadata is missing.

Task T029 explicitly states it does NOT apply Bonferroni correction to the primary p-value, reserving it only for T033. This violates spec.md SC-002 which requires the final validation report to include a 'Bonferroni‑corrected permutation‑test p‑value' to verify the success criterion. The deliverable falls short of the spec's acceptance condition.

Task T025 trains the model to predict CAPE, citing spec FR-011. However, plan.md Summary explicitly defines the target as 'Raw Packing Coefficient (PC_raw)' and treats CAPE as a 'diagnostic covariate'. The task silently adopts the spec's target over the plan's, creating a semantic drift where the implementation contradicts the approved implementation plan's core scientific definition without explicit plan revision.

Tasks T060-T064 implement features based on 'simulated reviewer comments' (Kandel, Pauling, etc.) not present in spec.md or plan.md. This introduces unapproved scope creep and violates the principle that tasks must strictly trace to spec/plan requirements, effectively weakening the project's defined scope by adding unverified scientific constraints.

Task T051 enforces a hard failure if 10,000 shuffles exceed 6 hours, removing the spec.md Assumption's explicit fallback mechanism ('number of permutations may be reduced'). This semantic weakening of the performance constraint risks pipeline failure on standard CI runners where the spec explicitly allowed a deviation.
